changeinfo.changes:
• Added Lottie costume for Raid mode character Cipher.
  • Added Rachael costume for Raid mode character Gina.
  • Added Lady HUNK costume for Raid mode character Gina.
  • Added Mutant Pedro costume for Raid mode character Pedro.
  • Improved Raid mode multiplayer stability.
  • Fixed flickering of objects that could occur throughout the game when firing a weapon.
  • Fixed the color of some enemy weak points.
  • Fixed lighting on multiple objects.
  • Added the Quick Match option accessible from the Raid mode red door.
  • Fixed controls and zoom levels in figurine viewer.
  • Concept art and secret files are now properly scaled to fit the screen.
  • Fixed the color of the cursor in the box puzzles to be more visible when at the wrong location.
  • Fixed visual artifacts when pointing a light at Natalia while she is crouching.

• Added Polar Bear Lottie costume for Raid mode character Cipher.
  • Added Jessica costume for Raid mode character Gina.
  • Added Ad Hoc Raid mode.
  • Fixed friend invitation in Raid mode.
  • Added support for additional buttons on a paired wireless controller.
  • Adjusted the brightness setting for a better horror experience.

• Paused enemy activity during loading times.
  • Added gamma settings.
  • Fixed the microphone activity icon during online Raid mode.
  • Fixed date and time information in the saved game.
  • Fixed a crash in the Raid mode mission IX-04.
• Fixed an infinite loading that could occur during the store checkout dialog.
